race.comment: ZAMORA (4) is the one to beat after missing by just over half a length at St Arnaud as favourite, and he now reaches the right stage of his campaign on a 10-day back-up that the profile says should suit. He also had ENIGMATISE behind him there, which gives the lead selection a clear recent reference. ENIGMATISE (7) is a genuine danger after being beaten just under a length at St Arnaud despite being tightened, and she should take improvement from that first-up run, although her record at around 1170m is still more place than win. BELMASAI (5) brings a strong BM56-to-BM52 set-up, handles soft ground and had already beaten ZAMORA at Manangatang, so his recent fourths read well for this grade. MONTROCK (8) is less convincing on raw finishing positions, but last start in BM56 grade came with a wide run throughout and the class drop plus 2kg claim give him a better chance to rebound.
